# Marked

This directory retains the dependency-free ESM lexer from
[Marked 18.0.13](https://www.npmjs.com/package/marked/v/18.0.13) for authored
operations that need rendered Markdown structure without an adopter-side
package installation.

`marked.esm.js` and `LICENSE` come from the published `marked@18.0.13` npm
package (`sha1-f642286759fcd640b29c1ea7b0d964a63afc01e3`). Keep the directory as an
explicit operation resource when wiring declarations.
